projects.title: Bedrock
projects.description: Bedrock is a tamper-proof automated pill dispenser designed to protect people from the misuse of prescription medication. Based off of a Raspberry Pi system with simple electronics and clean design philosophy. Submitted at PennApps XX - Fall 2019 at the University of Pennsylvania. Awarded Top 10 Hack out of over 250 teams and presented in Irvine Auditorium at the University of Pennsylvania.
